youtube.title: Which country is home to the smallest bird on Earth? 🪶
youtube.description:
The Amazon giant, the rainforest paradise, or the third one? The smallest bird on Earth is about as long as your thumb and lighter than a coin, lives on one island and nowhere else, beats its wings dozens of times a second and lays an egg the size of a coffee bean.
Which did you pick?

facebook.text:
Which country is home to the smallest bird — Brazil, Costa Rica or Cuba?
It is about as long as your thumb and lighter than a coin, lives on one island and nowhere else, beats its wings dozens of times a second and lays an egg the size of a coffee bean in a nest no bigger than a thimble. Pick your flag before the chart comes up.
